summary: Master policy monitoring, evaluation and learning to improve policy evidence, reporting, and adaptive action through practical templates and dashboards.
lede: Policy evaluation training helps policy professionals assess implementation, evidence, and progress toward intended results. Participants practice setting indicators and baselines, building monitoring dashboards, and using approaches such as contribution analysis and outcome harvesting to interpret findings. They also practice turning evidence into learning agendas, stakeholder reports, and action plans for policy revision.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with policy implementation, monitoring, evaluation, or reporting and need a more disciplined way to turn evidence into action.
modules: Policy Performance Reporting and Action Planning
prerequisites: You should bring a policy, programme, or reform context you already work on, plus any existing indicator list, reporting template, or review notes you can use in the exercises. A laptop is recommended for dashboard and template work, and familiarity with spreadsheets will help you work faster through the applied tasks.
